item_text.english: Description of Sakamoto's letter.
Detailed description of Sakamoto's letter.
A pass to the old Rengokukan facility.
A pass to the old Rengokukan facility. They say it's deep in Derelict Alley.
A bento supposedly eaten by a legendary carpenter.
Supposedly eaten by a legendary carpenter. Unkei and Kaikei await it. Inside: Otae's special bento of burnt eggs.
Hokuto Shinken's special ramen.
Hokuto Shinken ramen, slightly firm for delivery. It's getting cold while you read this. Hurry!!
Hokuto Shinken's special pan-fried gyoza.
Hokuto Shinken gyoza: lots of garlic, no stink. It's getting cold while you read this. Hurry!!
Hokuto Shinken's special fried rice.
Hokuto Shinken fried rice. Simple, popular, the shop's signature taste. It's cooling while you read! Hurry!!
Hokuto Shinken's special mapo tofu.
Hokuto Shinken mapo tofu: sweetness, spice and tofu in harmony. It's cooling while you read! Hurry!!
Hokuto Shinken's special soba.
Hokuto Shinken's surprise new staple: soba even Katsura approves of. It's cooling while you read! Hurry!!
A rare space flower wanted by florist Hedoro.
Hedoro wants this rare space flower. Deliver it to him to help Teruhiko find a birthday gift.
An ordinary Jump. Priceless if you missed that issue.
Just an issue of Jump. Missed it? It's priceless. Anyone who's been there could cry.
Right part of the Neo Armstrong Cyclone Jet Armstrong Cannon.
Right part of the Neo Armstrong Cyclone Jet Armstrong Cannon. Gather all three parts to complete the legendary weapon.
Left part of the Neo Armstrong Cyclone Jet Armstrong Cannon.
Left part of the Neo Armstrong Cyclone Jet Armstrong Cannon. Gather all three parts to complete the legendary weapon.
Center of the Neo Armstrong Cyclone Jet Armstrong Cannon.
Central part of the Neo Armstrong Cyclone Jet Armstrong Cannon. Gather all three parts to complete the legendary weapon.
A letter from Smile's Oryo to Sakamoto.
Oryo's letter to Sakamoto. A reply to his earlier letter? Or maybe...?
A letter from Sakamoto to Oryo.
Sakamoto's letter to Oryo. It's full of his feelings for her.
A photo of rising idol Tsu Terakado.
A photo of rising idol Tsu Terakado. Said to be rare. Otsu fans dream of owning it.
An autograph board signed by idol Tsu Terakado.
An autograph board signed by Edo's own idol Tsu Terakado. Enough to make any Otsu fan faint.
A dog translator. Works on doglike creatures, too.
A translator for dogs and doglike creatures. Build a better bond with your pet!
Gengai's copy of Kagura's umbrella. Special features...?
Gengai's copy of Kagura's umbrella. Special features...? A shocking truth awaits on Derelict Building Street?
A generous free-dango promotion voucher.
Trade this in at the dango shop for free dango! And the used stub gives you a second chance at a prize!!
The used stub of a Free Dango Voucher.
Take this stub to Oedo Mart for strawberry milk... apparently.
Gintoki's scooter key. Fast travel to certain places.
Gintoki's scooter key. Use it to zip to certain places. Feels like warp drive?!
Ikumatsu's underwear, seized from Fundoshi Mask.
Ikumatsu's underwear, seized from Fundoshi Mask. Given what it is, we'd better return it to her...
Otae's underwear, seized from Fundoshi Mask.
Otae's underwear, seized from Fundoshi Mask. Given what it is, we'd better return it to her...
Ayame's underwear, seized from Fundoshi Mask.
Ayame's underwear, seized from Fundoshi Mask. Given what it is, we'd better return it to her...
Otose's underwear, seized from Fundoshi Mask.
Otose's underwear, seized from Fundoshi Mask. Given what it is, we'd better return it to her...
Otsu's underwear, seized from Fundoshi Mask.
Otsu's underwear, seized from Fundoshi Mask. Given what it is, we'd better return it to her...
An ordinary manju, often used as an offering.
An ordinary manju, often used as an offering. Maybe we all need room in our hearts for that now and then?
Shinsengumi phone. Call a patrol car for fast travel.
Shinsengumi-issued phone. Call a patrol car to zip to certain places. Feels like warp drive?!
